column1: # ANALYZE: line facts, target blocks, liveness solver, SCAN and DEADQ.
# Memory bases, kinds and fresh continuations are bound; SIMPLE reads live opinfo facts.
# Pass A: label names are scoped by round, preserving the first definition.
# Classify ret/jump/jumpz/call/frame; other words consult the live SIMPLE table.
# Pass B: resolve named targets to blocks after all label definitions are known.
# For zlo..5, solve liveness in at most 64 rounds, traversing blocks backwards.
# From sc_l: determine whether sc_z is read before being written.
# A register is dead only after convergence and a negative SCAN result.
